tasks.title: Create Order + OrderItem entities + migration
tasks.notes: Order: id, orderNumber, status, totalVnd, cashierId, storeId, paymentMethod, createdAt. OrderItem: id, orderId, productId, productName, sku, quantity, unitPriceVnd, taxRatePercent, lineTotalVnd. Auto-index on (storeId, createdAt) for list queries.

tasks.title: Implement orderNumber auto-generation per store per day
tasks.notes: Use DB sequence per store. Format: {storePrefix}-{YYYYMMDD}-{seq:04d}.

tasks.title: Implement OrdersModule: create, add item, remove item, get order
tasks.notes: POST /orders, POST /orders/:id/items, DELETE /orders/:id/items/:itemId, GET /orders/:id. Price+tax snapshot on item add. totalVnd recalculated on every mutation.

tasks.title: Implement state machine: confirm-payment, cancel, refund-stub
tasks.notes: POST /orders/:id/confirm-payment (pending→processing), POST /orders/:id/cancel (pending→cancelled). Refund transition stub for Sprint 4.

tasks.title: Implement internal OrderCompletedEvent (for invoice module trigger)
tasks.notes: Use NestJS EventEmitter2. Order module emits event; Invoice module listens. Decoupled.

tasks.title: Implement GET /orders list with filters (status, date range, cashierId)
tasks.notes: Cashier sees own orders only. Manager/accountant/admin see all store orders. paginated, page=20.

tasks.title: Write unit tests: OrdersService state machine transitions
tasks.notes: Cover all valid + invalid transitions. Cover cross-store isolation. Cover item add after non-pending state.

tasks.title: Frontend: POS cart screen — search product + add to cart
tasks.notes: Real-time product search, cart sidebar, line item display with VNĐ formatting.

tasks.title: Frontend: Confirm payment modal + order completion flow
tasks.notes: Payment method selection (cash/card), confirm button, redirect to invoice view on success.

tasks.title: Frontend: Order history list for manager
tasks.notes: Table with filters: status, date range. Link to order detail.
